subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should this public MiMo hidden-reasoning exposure be repaired through the normal provider bug path, or routed through security handling before any new fix PR is opened?
rationale: The code fix appears narrow, but a maintainer already closed the proposed PR while keeping this issue open for the owner/security decision, and ClawSweeper should not decide that boundary automatically.

options.title: Owner/security review first
options.body: Keep automated fix PRs paused until a maintainer confirms the security handling and desired provider-owned repair shape.

options.title: Approve normal provider repair
options.body: Treat this as a public P1 provider bug and allow a narrow Xiaomi-only fix with tests and redacted live MiMo proof.

options.title: Require private security route
options.body: Move repair discussion out of the public issue if maintainers decide hidden-reasoning exposure needs private handling.

recommendation.title: Owner/security review first
recommendation.body: Keep automated fix PRs paused until a maintainer confirms the security handling and desired provider-owned repair shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest live owner-boundary signal because vincentkoc closed the linked fix PR and stated the issue should stay open for owner/security decision and live proof.
